scientific_integrity: Analytical proof reconstructs the quota inequality, explicit algorithm and mandatory unassigned-item blocking; finite independent-rule checker is supplementary, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Identical unit additive goods, complete multipartite conflict graphs, partial feasible allocations; no claims for unequal weights, nonmultipartite graphs, complete allocations or Pareto efficiency. Relevant unindexed coloring theorems remain priority risk.
title: Maximal EF1 for unit goods on complete multipartite conflict graphs with arbitrarily many agents
